reference_title: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Deployment
note: VCF Automation has no published API specification. It is absent from the Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository and no VMware.Sdk.Vcf PowerCLI module covers it, so docs/contract.json was transcribed from the rendered xAPIs reference pages recorded below. Every page that contributed to the contract is listed with the operation it documents and the date it was fetched.

pages.documents: Broadcom Developer Portal xAPIs index; located the VCF Automation API families, including VM Apps Org - Deployment.
VCF Automation API 9.1, VM Apps Org - Deployment landing page; API title, version and operation categories.
Security schemes; bearerAuth, type http, bearer format JWT, sent in the Authorization header.
Deployments operation index; confirms GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/resources is named Get Deployment Resources.

Get Deployment Resources; GET /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}/resources, path and query parameters, PageDeploymentResource and DeploymentResource response schemas, status codes 200/401/404.
Resource Actions operation index; confirms GET /deployment/api/resources/{resourceId}/actions is named Get Resource Actions.
Get Resource Actions; GET /deployment/api/resources/{resourceId}/actions, resourceId path parameter, no query parameters, array of ResourceAction including the valid flag, status codes 200/401/404.
Requests operation index; confirms POST /deployment/api/resources/{resourceId}/requests is named Submit Resource Action Request and is distinct from Submit Deployment Action Request.

Submit Resource Action Request; POST /deployment/api/resources/{resourceId}/requests, application/json ResourceActionRequest body whose actionId, inputs and reason members are all optional, Request response schema, status codes 200/401/403/404/409.
